posts.title: Palantir and Anduril
posts.description: Tolkien would be horrified, but not surprised, to learn that key aspects of his world have been bent, as the Orcs were fashioned by Morgoth, to serve purposes antithetical to the grand scope of all that Middle-earth stood for. I’m sure this has been noted by others before me.
